in_sanskrit.name: Najir
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Victory of the Gods
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Najir एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'naj-' meaning victory, and '-ir' meaning the gods. This name evokes the triumphant power of the divine and is bestowed upon children born into families who seek divine favor and protection.
